nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Integration test module registry that declares all ~35 integration test submodules (SIT and UAT), with several conditionally compiled under feature flags such as `web-server` and `grpc-server`. Recently extended with `react_e2e_sit` for E2E goal-driven ReAct tests.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure `mod` declaration file — a Rust barrel that registers every sibling test file with the integration_suite binary. Feature-gated modules (`#[cfg(feature = ...)]`) are excluded from the minimal `petgraph_backend` build.
